purpose: Teach: 君主/真空/放射能/被爆/高官/元来/堕落/精霊

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、君主制の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper was on the history of monarchy, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, steady opening. Genuine curiosity — not testing, confirming. Patient pause after the name, giving space for attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、真空中の物理現象を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper covered physical phenomena in a vacuum.
lines.style: Direct and clear. Slight lift of certainty, offering the correction without defensiveness. Meets her gaze level.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 放射能被害の長期影響を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And the long-term effects of radiation exposure — that was your topic, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentler this time, more reflective. A slight lean-forward, as if the weight of the subject matter settles the voice lower and slower.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、被爆地の医療を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on medical care in areas affected by the bombing.
lines.style: Grounded and serious. No apology in the correction. Voice sits steady and clear, honoring the gravity of the subject.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政府高官への取材結果を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And your research included interviews with government officials, didn't it?
lines.style: Engaged and present. Slight nod of recognition built into the delivery. Warm but not casual — respecting the scope of her work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、元来の伝統文化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper examined comparisons of spirit-faith traditions.
lines.style: Clear correction, steady delivery. A hint of quiet pride in the substance of the work. No rushing — each word held with care.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会の堕落と再生を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Social decay and renewal — I remember that being central to your argument, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly philosophical. The cadence slows as if turning over the ideas. Genuine reflection, not recitation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、精霊信仰の比較を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I explored comparisons across different spirit-faith traditions.
lines.style: Final answer, grounded and complete. Slight warmth breaking through — pride in the work done, subtly visible. Small satisfied closure.
